intro: Every public papyrus fibre set we know of for the Herculaneum scrolls, ours and other people's, linked where its makers host it (nothing below is copied here except our own six). Checked 27 October 2026; tell us about any we missed.

note: Fibre curves are model output (or, for the annotators' sets, hand tracing) about papyrus structure: geometry, not a reading of any text. Each set keeps its makers' terms; scans are Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0.
